Gold, Silver, Copper and Critical Minerals Companies Present at the Precious Metals & Critical Minerals Virtual Investor Conference, October 13 to 15
The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement.
Lineup Spans Gold, Silver, Copper, Nickel, Rare Earths, Phosphate, Uranium and Royalties, and Every Session Ends With Audience Q&A
From Early-Stage Exploration to Producing Mines, Management Teams Take Investor Meeting Requests

invites investors to the Precious Metals & Critical Minerals Virtual Investor Conference, a B2i Digital Featured Conference, taking place online from Tuesday, October 13, to Thursday, October 15, 2026, and hosted by Virtual Investor Conferences.

As the Official Marketing Partner, B2i Digital brings the conference and every presenting company into an ecosystem built since 2021 and proven at over 130 investor conferences: 1,200+ news, broadcast and trade outlets with a 330 million+ monthly audience, and a community of 1.7 million+ investors and market participants. No single channel carries the day. It is the compounding effect of all online and offline channels, working before, during and after the event, that turns attention into meetings.
Two B2i Digital Featured Companies present: Canadian Phosphate Limited on October 13 and Renforth Resources Inc. on October 15.

Any registered investor can request a virtual meeting with the management team of a presenting company through the meeting link above.
Each company presents live with audience Q&A. Replays will be available on the B2i Digital and OTC Markets YouTube channels.

“The lineup keeps growing, which tells you mining companies want the market’s attention and the market wants to hear from them. They’re called critical minerals for a reason. Find out why, and who is best equipped to deliver them. Then request your one-on-one meetings. As I’ve said before, that’s the unique opportunity the VIC offers,” said David Shapiro, Chief Executive Officer of B2i Digital, Inc.

Throughout the year, Virtual Investor Conferences feature public companies from exchanges worldwide, including NYSE, Nasdaq, TSX, TSXV, CSE, ASX, LSE, and the OTC Markets. Virtual Investor Conferences is an OTC Markets Group Inc. property.

B2i Digital, Inc. partners with conferences, public companies, and capital markets advisors through its Featured Conference, Featured Company, and Featured Expert programs. Its media network spans 1,200+ news, broadcast, and trade outlets with a 330 million+ combined monthly audience, plus 1.7 million+ followers, 70,000 opt-in email subscribers, and a rolodex of 235,000+ capital markets contacts. That reach gets clients seen; its conferences put them in the room with investors. The Capital Markets Matchmaker℠ takes every story From Marketing to Meetings℠. B2i Digital is headquartered in New York City.
Discover more Featured Companies, Featured Experts, and upcoming Featured Conferences at b2idigital.com.

Virtual Investor Conferences is the proprietary investor conference series that provides an interactive forum for publicly traded companies to meet directly with investors online. VIC offers companies efficient access to a broad investor audience through live presentations, Q&A sessions, and one-on-one meetings. Investors benefit from direct access to executive management teams and the ability to view presentations live or on demand.
